about: Independent expected outcomes for package rawinput. Raw inputs are literal text. Placeholders: ${MODEL} (lifecycle.ModelDigest), ${OTHER_MODEL} (a different valid 64-hex digest), ${D:name} (hex SHA-256 of digests[name]); tokens {{xHH}} (one raw byte) and {{rep:N|unit}} (unit repeated N times). Expectation kinds: ok (full result task literal in task or taskText), refused (refusals literal; unchanged:true means the result task equals the parsed input task, nil and empty slices and null and empty owner preserved), invalid (reducer INVALID_INPUT, nil Task, nil error), rejected (non-nil *InputError with the named input and reason; reducer result is the INVALID_INPUT literal).

revisionMatrix.about: Each rejected value is placed, as a JSON string, in task.revision, command.expectedRevision and review.taskRevision, with the other input valid. Each wrongType token is placed raw in the same positions and must give strict_json.
